title: Izwi reKutsigira
intro: Kare kare munhu wekutanga asati afamba panyika, chisikwa chine simba guru chakamira munzvimbo ine rugare rwakakwana, chakakomberedzwa nemweya yakazvipira zvikuru. Pakataurwa murayiro mumwe chete, inzwi rega rega rakakotama richizviisa pasi—asi izwi rimwe chete rakamuka richiramba, uye kuramba ikoko kwaizonzwika muzera rega rega kusvika paZuva rekupedzisira. Ndiani chisikwa ichi chakawa?
clues: Ndakasikwa kubva pane chimwe chinhu chaipenya zvikuru, nepo vamwe vaiva padivi pangu vakaumbwa kubva pane zvavakafamba pamusoro pazvo.
Ndakagara munzvimbo tsvene pakati pezvisikwa zvakazvipira, kusvikira murairo mumwe chete wachinja zvese.
Pakauya murairo, mweya wese wakakotama kunze kwangu; kuramba kwangu kwakakonzerwa nekuzvikudza.
Ndakadzingwa panzvimbo tsvene iyoyo, ndakaiswa chituko chaizogara nekusingaperi.
Ndakakumbira nguva kusvika pazuva rerumuko, uye yakagamuchirwa. Ndakapika kuti ndichaswedera kumweya wese ndoitsausa.
Kana hwamanda yarira, avo vanonditevera vachagovana neni mugumo wangu, vachibatana neni mumoto unopfuta uko pasina mubatsiri anogona kuvaponesa.

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
